question: Which organisation(s) are involved in the development of the 'Joint Parcel Product' (JPP), which was commenced during 2022 in India?

options.text: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indian Railways and India Post**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Railways** and **India Post** collaborated to develop the **'Joint Parcel Product' (JPP)** in 2022.
 
• The JPP initiative was designed to create a seamless and integrated **logistics network** for parcel delivery.
